apps.name: Activepieces
apps.what_is_sent: A daily snapshot of the deployment shape such as replica counts, resource sizes, versions and settings. Product analytics adds tracked events and in-app page view counts.

disable.instructions: Turn off the deployment snapshot in the UI under Platform Admin > Account > Configurations. It does not read AP_TELEMETRY_ENABLED.

disable.name: AP_TELEMETRY_ENABLED
disable.note: Only seeds the product analytics setting the first time it is read. After that the UI toggle controls it.

apps.notes: The deployment snapshot is documented as on by default. The docs do not state the default for product analytics or name the destination host.

apps.name: Appsmith
apps.what_is_sent: Anonymous navigation, click and successful backend-call events.
apps.still_sent: Keep-alive and server-setup pings are sent whether telemetry is on or off.
apps.notes: api.mixpanel.com is the endpoint shown in the sample payloads in the docs. It is shared with other products that use Mixpanel.

apps.name: Arize Phoenix
apps.what_is_sent: Basic web analytics about interactions with the Phoenix web interface. No trace or evaluation data.
apps.notes: PHOENIX_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_RESOURCES=false is meant for air-gapped installs and also blocks other external resources. The docs page does not name the destination host.

apps.name: Chatwoot
apps.what_is_sent: Anonymised metadata such as aggregate record counts, inbox and conversation type distributions and enabled integrations, sent periodically.
apps.notes: The docs say self-hosted installations periodically send this data and give the variable as the way to stop it. They do not use the word "default".

apps.name: Coder
apps.what_is_sent: Usage and deployment metadata such as feature and template details, plus the administrator's email. No secrets or end-user identities.
apps.notes: The docs page does not name the destination host.

apps.name: Documenso
apps.what_is_sent: App version, an installation ID and a node ID, sent on server startup and with a periodic heartbeat.
apps.notes: The docs say "our telemetry servers" without naming a host, so no destination is listed.

apps.name: Firezone
apps.notes: Unverified. The source page could not be opened when this entry was written, so the default and the variable come from a search engine summary of that page. The image name was not checked either. That summary describes the legacy self-hosted release and says the variable turns off product telemetry. Whether it also covers package and firezone-ctl telemetry is not known.

apps.name: Grafana
apps.what_is_sent: Anonymous usage statistics.

disable.name: GF_ANALYTICS_CHECK_FOR_UPDATES
disable.note: Stops the check for new Grafana versions.

disable.name: GF_ANALYTICS_CHECK_FOR_PLUGIN_UPDATES
disable.note: Stops the check for new plugin versions.

apps.notes: The docs give the config keys and the GF_<SECTION>_<KEY> rule for environment variables. The variable names here follow that rule.

apps.name: Hasura GraphQL Engine
apps.what_is_sent: Anonymous, aggregate usage statistics from the server, Console and CLI, such as object counts and error events.
apps.notes: The docs describe telemetry as something you opt out of. They do not use the word "default".

apps.name: Immich machine learning
apps.what_is_sent: Anonymous ONNX Runtime metric data, sent to Microsoft by the bundled onnxruntime library.

disable.name: ORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY
disable.note: Only needed on versions before v3.3.6. The image sets it itself from v3.3.6.

apps.notes: Caused by onnxruntime turning telemetry on by default in a recent release, so older Immich versions that bundle an older onnxruntime are not affected. phonehome cannot tell the version from a moving tag such as "release".

apps.name: Langfuse
apps.what_is_sent: High-level aggregated usage metrics such as version, project and trace totals. No raw traces, prompts or email addresses.
apps.still_sent: Enterprise self-hosted telemetry is used for license compliance and cannot be disabled.

disable.name: TELEMETRY_ENABLED
disable.note: Set it on every Langfuse application container.

apps.name: Lightdash
apps.what_is_sent: Usage events tied to organization, project, user and content UUIDs, plus some resource titles, descriptions and short error messages. No SQL, query results or credentials.

disable.name: RUDDERSTACK_ANALYTICS_DISABLED
disable.note: Set it on every container that runs Lightdash code (backend, scheduler, workers).

apps.name: Meilisearch
apps.what_is_sent: Anonymized system, performance and usage metrics, sent in batches through Segment.
apps.notes: The docs name Segment as the collector but give no hostname, so no destination is listed.

apps.name: n8n
apps.what_is_sent: Anonymous usage telemetry, sent mostly at event time, plus execution counts and an instance pulse every 6 hours.

disable.name: N8N_TEMPLATES_ENABLED
disable.note: Stops workflow template fetching. Templates stop working in the UI.

apps.notes: The docs do not name the destination hosts, so none are listed.

apps.name: Netdata
apps.what_is_sent: Anonymous system, configuration and alert/chart count data on agent start, stop and fatal errors, plus product usage events from the dashboard.
apps.notes: The docs name a Netdata cloud function and PostHog as the receivers but give no hostnames, so no destination is listed.

apps.name: Novu
apps.what_is_sent: Usage statistics such as event, integration, organization, subscriber, topic, user and workflow counts.
apps.still_sent: An hourly keep-alive ping (hostname, instance ID, IP address, platform, release, memory figures) is sent whether telemetry is on or off.

disable.instructions: Telemetry can also be turned off in the Admin Settings.

apps.notes: Unverified. The docs do not state the default, do not name the destination host, and do not say which container reads NOVU_TELEMETRY. The image name was not checked against the official compose file.

apps.name: OpenSEO
apps.what_is_sent: A self_host.heartbeat event with an install ID, version, deploy target, database backend and aggregate counts such as users and projects.

disable.name: OPENSEO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED
disable.note: Any value other than 0, false, no or off opts out. Those four keep telemetry on.

apps.notes: Taken from the project source. The README and Docker self-hosting guide do not mention telemetry.

apps.name: PowerSync Service
apps.what_is_sent: Usage counters and gauges such as bytes synced and replication lag, collected every few minutes and tied to a random instance UUID.
apps.notes: The docs say the metrics go to PowerSync without naming a host. The opt-out is a config key, so phonehome cannot write a fix for it.

apps.name: Qdrant
apps.what_is_sent: Anonymized system information, performance timings and counters, and critical error reports such as backtraces.
apps.notes: The docs page does not name the destination host.

apps.name: SigNoz
apps.what_is_sent: Deployment platform, OS, build version and variant, counts of dashboards, alerts and users, and ingested data volume. User emails too unless identity collection is turned off.

disable.instructions: v0.88.0 and later: set statsreporter.enabled to false in the SigNoz configuration. To keep reporting but drop emails, set statsreporter.collect.identities to false.
Before v0.88.0: set TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false in the query-service environment and restart query-service.

apps.notes: The opt-out depends on the version, so phonehome does not write a fix for it. The docs do not name the destination host.

apps.name: TimescaleDB
apps.what_is_sent: An anonymous JSON usage report with the instance's versions, operating system, database feature counts and job statistics.
apps.notes: The default telemetry level is "basic". The opt-out is a PostgreSQL setting, so phonehome cannot write a fix for it. The docs page does not name the destination host.

apps.name: Weaviate
apps.what_is_sent: Server version, OS and architecture, module names, object and collection counts, cluster details and client library usage. No data objects, collection names or property names.
